title: Appending a sign leaves the monomial unchanged
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a subset of the first $k$ coordinate indices, let $x$ be a vector of $k$ signs, and let $b$ be another sign. Embed $T$ into the first $k$ coordinates of a vector of length $k+1$, and append $b$ to $x$; the monomial indexed by the embedded set at the extended vector equals the monomial indexed by $T$ at $x$.
